moodys.citation_text: Universe v2 file: 'Moody's Baa2 to Baa3' in May 2023, implying Baa2 starting; 'Was Baa2 January 2023, now Ba1/BB+'.

sp.citation_text: S&P not referenced. Fitch is the second active rater.

fitch.citation_text: Butler Eagle June 2023: 'Credit agency downgrades Butler Health rating to BBB' (Fitch). Universe v2: 2024-12 Fitch BBB- to BB+, so BBB starting 2022 is consistent.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Moody's downgraded Butler Health System's rating twice since May 2023, sending it from Baa3 to Ba1 by March 2024' implies May 2023 action was Baa2 -> Baa3.
Butler Eagle June 2023: 'Credit agency downgrades Butler Health rating to BBB' — Fitch action. Subsequent Dec 2024 action then took BBB- to BB+.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Moody's downgrades Butler Hospital bond rating again' — April 2024 Butler Eagle article; brought Moody's to Ba1.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: DSCR covenant breach FY2024 (0.39x vs 1.10x required); forbearance agreement; operating pressures continue.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch downgraded Butler Health rating again despite improved results — December 2024 Butler Eagle.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Butler County commissioners approve forbearance agreement Dec 2024; covers FY23 and FY24 DSCR covenant breaches; softens covenants for FY25.

moodys.citation_text: March 2024 Ba1 in effect at window end.

fitch.citation_text: Dec 2024 BB+ in effect at window end.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's executed two consecutive notch downgrades (Baa2->Baa3 May 2023; Baa3->Ba1 March 2024) for cumulative 2 notches, AND Fitch executed two notch downgrades (BBB->BBB- June 2023; BBB- -> BB+ Dec 2024) for cumulative 2 notches. Both Moody's and Fitch crossed the IG/sub-IG threshold. Active covenant breach (FY23 DSCR -2.28x, FY24 DSCR 0.39x vs 1.10x covenant). Forbearance agreement Dec 2024.
